title: .data.data requests get double stripped
author: jacobparis
body_preview: ### Reproduction  Bug in latest React Router 7 when v8_passThroughRequests is NOT enabled  Any route `/items/:id`, a when URL is `/items/foo.data`  - single fetch requests go to `/items/foo.data.data` (good) - loaders and actions receive params.id === "foo" (bad)   So the SSR side works with document id `foo` and the SPA side works with document id `foo.data` leaving half the page inconsistent....
